about.heading: About
paragraphs: I'm an AI engineer based in Kocaeli, Türkiye. I like owning a problem end to end: preparing the data, training the model, serving it through an API and building the screen people use.

I've worked in data, machine learning and e-commerce teams across three internships. In the latest one I built the system that writes product descriptions for brand catalogs on Trendyol with AI and sends every one of them to a person for approval. These days I work mostly on predictive maintenance for factories and on assistants built on large language models.

focus.title: LLM applications
focus.text: Content generation, customer-service bots and assistants that use tools. I check model output against rules and leave the final call to a person.

focus.title: Predictive maintenance
focus.text: Models that warn about machine failures from sensor data, and screens a maintenance team can read at a glance.

focus.title: Machine learning
focus.text: Classification, forecasting and anomaly detection with LightGBM, scikit-learn, PyTorch and graph neural networks.

focus.title: End-to-end products
focus.text: Backends in Python and FastAPI, interfaces in React and Next.js, shipped with Docker and GitHub Actions.

work.heading: Selected projects
work.lede: Models trained on public datasets, a live demo, and a system that ran on a real client's catalog.

projects.title: MaintAgent
projects.text: An AI maintenance assistant for industrial machines. From sensor data it predicts the risk of failure in the next 24 hours and the part most likely to fail, and shows which signals drove each prediction. Next up is the LLM assistant that investigates a fault with tools and drafts the work order.
points: Microsoft Azure Predictive Maintenance data, processed with SQL on DuckDB
Multiclass LightGBM model for risk and the likely part
13 automated tests, including one that checks the model never sees the future

projects.title: Kocaeli Factory Intelligence
projects.text: A predictive-maintenance dashboard for production lines. From machine telemetry it produces a 24-hour failure risk, an anomaly score and the first maintenance step for the shift. The model runs right in the browser.
points: Trained on 8 machines and 4,608 synthetic readings
66% precision and 53% recall on a time-based test split
Scenario alarms and model predictions are shown separately

image.alt: The Kocaeli Factory Intelligence dashboard showing machine risk and anomaly scores

projects.title: Trendyol SEO description system
projects.text: A Python system that pulls products from the Trendyol Seller API and writes SEO descriptions with OpenAI. Every description is checked against marketplace rules; a failing one is rewritten, and all of them go to a person for approval before anything is published.
points: Banned-claim, HTML and length checks, with up to two retries
A review sheet that puts the original and new description side by side
In the same internship, a Next.js review screen for AI-generated images

projects.title: NeoBioAI
projects.text: A graph neural network that predicts binding affinity from a molecule's structure. It is served with FastAPI; the Next.js interface shows which atoms drive a prediction, scores CSV batches and writes a summary report with an LLM.
points: GINEConv network trained on the PDBBind dataset
Fast prediction on a single CPU thread

stats.k: Pearson r on the test set

items.title: Clinic AI assistant
items.text: A Turkish chatbot for dental and aesthetic clinics. It answers price and service questions from the clinic's profile, never diagnoses and sends appointment requests to WhatsApp.

items.title: AI Basketball Coach
items.text: A computer-vision prototype that counts dribbles and steps from video and flags a possible travel. Built with my friend Osman.

items.title: VisionGuard AI
items.text: A UI demo of a quality-control and safety dashboard for production lines, with simulated detections and a real-time backend.
Built the Trendyol description system, and the Next.js review screen for AI-generated images in a 10-person team.
Prepared datasets in Python, and trained and evaluated models with scikit-learn.
Prepared machine learning datasets with SQL and pandas.
Graduation thesis: NeoBioAI. Certificates: Google AI Essentials, BTK Academy Machine Learning, Hugging Face NLP Course.
